tokenForm.lede: Tools for your agents to read your Play tracks, keep your upload key and send builds to testing. Every upload waits for you.

family.name: play
family.description: Google Play releases and app signing.

tools.name: play_tracks
tools.description: Every track of an app on Google Play and its releases: name, version codes, status, rollout.

package.description: The app's package name, such as com.example.app.

tools.name: play_upload
tools.description: Upload a signed .aab and release it on a track. Waits for the person to approve. An app still a draft in Play Console takes only status draft.

track.description: Default internal; also alpha, beta, production or a closed track's name.

status.description: Default completed: out to the track's testers once Play processes it.

name.description: Release name. Default: the version name.

tools.name: play_keystore
tools.description: The upload keys Sikemux keeps, or one keystore's alias, fingerprints, algorithm and expiry. Never a password.

path.description: A kept keystore. Default: every one.

tools.name: play_keystore_create
tools.description: Make a new upload keystore (RSA 4096, 27 years) with a password only Sikemux holds, and its certificate as .pem beside it. Never replaces a file.

path.description: Absolute path for the new .jks, outside the repository.

name.description: Who the certificate names. Default: Upload key.

tools.name: play_keystore_add
tools.description: Keep an existing upload keystore. Get its password with ask and secret: true, and pass the file that answer is in.

tools.name: play_sign
tools.description: Sign an .aab or .apk in place with a kept upload key, then verify it and answer the signer's SHA-256.

file.description: Absolute path. An .apk must be zipaligned first.

keystore.description: A kept keystore's path. Default: the only one kept.
